DR STEVENS HERBS · TERMS OF USE

Clear expectations, from the start.

Information to help you make a clear, informed choice.

General information

Content is for general information and product enquiries. It does not establish a clinician-patient relationship or provide a diagnosis, prescription or individual treatment plan.

Herb collections

Collection pages describe categories rather than specific formulations. The exact herb, ingredients, suitability, availability and price are discussed with Dr Stevens before an order is agreed. Botanical imagery is illustrative.

Enquiries and orders

Adding an item to the enquiry bag does not place an order. Any actual sale requires confirmation of products, price, payment, delivery and applicable terms directly with the business.

Medical guidance

Read the product information and discuss product questions with Dr Stevens before use. Ask Dr Stevens directly for guidance on the product, ingredients and how it fits your situation.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be directed to Dr Stevens Herbs at +1 (848) 448-7130.
